statement: An interpretable comparison needs, in the same neural cell: (a) each reagent with and without NRF2 loss shown adequate at nuclear NRF2 protein and at 2 target genes at the endpoint time; (b) a KEAP1-loss occlusion arm (the compound adds nothing once KEAP1 is gone); (c) the covalent and non-covalent reagents matched on on-target response (nuclear NRF2, 2 genes), not on concentration; (d) one readout class beside NQO1; (e) neurons and astrocytes separately because astrocytic NRF2 can act on neurons. A maintained response under an adequate loss means an alternative route; a lost response means dependence of that endpoint, not absolute specificity.
